title: First Unit of the Train That Will Serve the Mexico City-Pachuca Route Arrives
author: La Jornada Editorial Staff
content:
_This article by[La Jornada Editorial
Staff](https://www.jornada.com.mx/autores/la%20redacci%C3%B3n) originally
appeared in the [November 12, 2026 edition of La
Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/11/12/economia/llega-la-
primera-unidad-del-tren-que-dara-servicio-en-la-ruta-ciudad-de-mexicopachuca),
Mexico’s premier left wing daily newspaper._

**Mexico City.** As part of Railway Workers’ Day, commemorated every November
7, the Agency for Trains and Integrated Public Transport (ATTRAPI) received
last Saturday the first unit in the series of trains that will serve the new
Mexico City-Pachuca passenger route.

In a statement, the Secretariat of Infrastructure, Communications and
Transport (SICT) explained that the unit is **100 percent electric** and
arrived at the Pantaco rail terminal, located in northern Mexico City, from
the workshops of the company CRRC in Zhuzhou, China, which it left in August
of this year.

With a length of 102 meters, the train has the capacity to carry **893
passengers**. It has priority seating, spaces for luggage and bicycles, as
well as an interior and exterior video surveillance system, features that help
provide a comfortable, safe and accessible service.

> “In total, 15 units will make up the fleet of this new service, which will
> connect the Buenavista terminal with Pachuca along a **100-kilometer route**
> ,” the SICT said.

Of these, 58 kilometers correspond to new electrified track, whose
construction is being carried out in coordination with the “Felipe Ángeles”
Engineers’ Group of the Secretariat of National Defense (Sedena), on the AIFA-
Pachuca section.

> [Post by @SICTmx on
> X](https://twitter.com/SICTmx/status/2120910987398115745)

This stage of the project calls for the construction of seven stations and one
terminal, which will connect different localities in the Pachuca metropolitan
area and the Valley of Mexico.

> “Daily demand is estimated at more than 100,000 passengers, with a **travel
> time of one hour and 15 minutes** between Buenavista and Pachuca,” the SICT
> indicated.

It also added that, to boost job creation, the rest of the rail fleet will be
assembled in Querétaro, which will contribute to regional economic
development.

The government seeks to bring back passenger trains as a modern, electric and
sustainable mobility alternative that will connect communities, bring
opportunities closer and strengthen the country’s economic and tourism
development.
